label: early original-phase input of v/m/b/j/a/k
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase (98% of mass), at early positions t=1..5 (peak t=2; never at t=0 or on <DEL>, and rarely in the copy phase). It is token-selective: v strongest (29% rate), then m, b, j, a, k, with weaker firing on p, i, 3. The predicate captures 81% of activation mass but only about 52% precision. Context modulates whether it fires and how strongly: the top activations (about 0.33) come when v/j/m/b follow o or o o early in the sequence, and restricting prev_tok to {o,k,p,u,j,r,n,a} raises precision to 0.84 but drops recall to 0.31. Activity is lower when earlier inputs include digits, and it is mostly on the first occurrence of a token. It does not fire on t=0, on the delimiter, or meaningfully on copy-phase outputs. The context dependence looks graded rather than a clean rule, so precision is incomplete.
